messages.subject: Shiny server permissions issue
parts:
Okay, when run locally on my PC, my update data button (that runs an update_data.R script) functions fine. This polls the twitter search api for new data and updates a .Rdata file if there's new data. But, once I move it over to an AWS ubuntu image, the update data button errors out with a "cannot open connection" error. Try it out here... http://107.22.187.183:3838/minneapolis-fp-tweets/

I set up the server using the tutorial, so the shiny stuff is running as a user called 'shiny'. So my first thought was to change ownership of all of the /var/shiny-server/www/minneapolis-fp-tweets files to 'shiny'. This didn't work. I also gave r and x permissions to all users to the update_data.R script and the search.R script that it calls. That didn't do it either. I also made sure everybody had write permission to the .Rdata file that the script is supposed to update.

Code is here... https://github.com/corynissen/minneapolis-fp-tweets/tree/master/minneapolis-fp-tweets

Any ideas?

Thanks
Cory
